name: ordinary-month
description: An unremarkable month. The hardest case: nothing dramatic to hang a devotion on.

notes.title: Tuesday
notes.text: Ran in the morning. Work was fine. Cooked properly for once.

notes.title: Small thing
notes.text: Noticed the light on the kitchen wall at about six. Stood there a minute.

notes.title: Reading
notes.text: Started the book again from the beginning. Slower this time.
